Attribute1975–
Number of Fatalities That Occurred in the Crash1-99

Notes

The data element is derived by counting all people with “Injury Severity” of 4 in the crash. The data element “Fatalities in Vehicle” in the Vehicle data file provides the number of deaths in a vehicle.
